franchisor: Valvoline Instant Oil Change Franchising, Inc.
format: one Valvoline Instant Oil Change service center (ground-up or conversion), land and improvements either leased or purchased

invest.quote: The estimated total investment necessary to begin operation of one Valvoline Instant Oil Change service center ranges from $192,375 to $3,483,550 per service center. This includes the $73,750 to $122,050 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay VIOCF a license fee of $30,000 for your first Center, regardless of whether the Center is new construction ... or a non-Valvoline Instant Oil Change facility that you convert
fee.note: Half paid at signing, half when the first royalty payment is due. Second Center: $20,000 (ground-up) or $5,000 (qualifying conversion); third Center: $5,000. Under a Development Agreement: $2,500 to $5,000 per Center plus a $5,000 development fee per Center (minimum 3). Buying a Center from an existing franchisee: $5,000 for the first, $2,500 for each subsequent Center from the same seller.

royalty.quote: Royalties For the first 12 months of the initial term, 2% of Adjusted Gross Revenue ("AGR"); for the second 12 months of the initial term, 3% of AGR, then 6% of AGR or a graduated royalty rate between 4% and 6% of AGR (See Note 2) Payable monthly by electronic funds transfer on the 20th day

adFund.quote: General System Fund Up to 2% of AGR for that fiscal year until the cap amount has been reached ... The annual cap amount for Centers to be opened in VIOCF's 2026 fiscal year is $7,344 but in no event shall exceed $7,500 per Center. Local Advertising Spend or Contribution At least 3% of AGR annually
adFund.note: General System Fund up to 2% of AGR, capped at $7,344 per Center per year for Centers opened in fiscal 2026 (never more than $7,500); local advertising at least 3% of AGR. A national advertising fund may be established at the beginning of fiscal 2027 (amount not yet determined).

otherRecurring.name: General System Fund annual cap (Centers opened in fiscal 2026)
otherRecurring.amount: Up to 2% of AGR until the annual cap of $7,344 per Center is reached (in no event more than $7,500)

otherRecurring.name: Signage Lease (if signage leased from VIOCF)
otherRecurring.amount: Estimated monthly lease payment is $375 to $650 for 120-month lease term

transferFee.amount: $30,000 for your first Center if transferred to a new franchisee; $5,000 for your first Center if transferred to an existing franchisee; and $2,500 for any additional Centers transferred in the same transaction.

item19.quote: FY 2025 - VIOCF Comparable Franchisee-Operated Centers ... Net Sales 891 $397,215 $5,728,187 $1,704,870 $1,844,172 386
item19.note: Franchised data are Net Sales only (Gross Sales less coupons, discounts, fleet discounts, refunds), no costs; excludes 172 Centers not franchise-operated for the full year. Contribution figures are for company-operated Centers only, exclude operating leases (rent), market and corporate overhead, depreciation and taxes; advertising is an allocated budget; royalty rows assume 4% although a single new Center pays 2%, 3% then 6% (or 4%-6% graduated). No contribution margin is printed as a % of sales.

special: Royalty steps up: 2% of AGR in year 1, 3% in year 2, then 6% (graduated 4%-6% available to existing franchisees whose centers exceed $1,000,000 combined AGR; Item 19 says 4% applies at $5,000,000+ combined AGR and 95% of franchise Centers paid 4%). You must buy VALVOLINE Products (motor oils, filters, lubricants, etc.) from VIOCF, an affiliate or a designated supplier, initially $28,750 to $62,050 and ongoing. Mandatory national fleet program pricing and 100% satisfaction guarantee at franchisee cost. Remodel obligation up to the greater of $50,000 or 2% of AGR over the previous five years. Investment range spans leased site ($192,375 to $639,550) and purchased land and building ($1,773,750 to $3,483,550).
issues: Item 19 profit data (Contribution) covers only company-operated Centers and is printed in dollars, not as a % of sales, so profitPct is null. Item 20 introduction misprints the fiscal year as '2054'. Royalty pct recorded as the standard 6% from year 3; 2%/3% intro years and 4%-6% graduated scale in special.
